title: Add Polls (create, vote, and percentage results)

requirements.text: Implement backend data models and stable storage for Polls, including: a poll question, a list of 2+ option labels, per-option vote counts, createdAt timestamp, and creator principal. Each authenticated principal can cast at most one vote per poll (changing vote should be supported by replacing their previous vote).

quotes: Make polls were you ask questions and put this or this and it shows what percentage of ppl like who

acceptanceCriteria: A poll record stores: question text, options (2+), createdAt, creator principal, and vote counts.
Voting is restricted to authenticated users; unauthenticated callers are rejected with a clear error (trap is acceptable if consistent with existing access control).
A principal can vote only once per poll; a subsequent vote updates their previous choice rather than incrementing totals twice.
Percentages can be derived reliably from stored totals (0-vote polls do not error).

requirements.text: Add backend canister APIs for polls: createPoll(question, options) -> pollId (or poll object), getPoll(pollId), getAllPolls (newest first), and votePoll(pollId, optionIndex). Ensure APIs follow the existing single-actor access-control pattern (only signed-in users can create/vote; all users can read).

quotes: Make polls were you ask questions and put this or this and it shows what percentage of ppl like who

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can create a poll with 2+ options and then retrieve it via getPoll and getAllPolls.
Guests can call getPoll/getAllPolls successfully.
votePoll updates the poll totals and per-user vote tracking as specified in REQ-40.
getAllPolls returns polls in reverse-chronological order (newest first).

requirements.text: Add/extend backend upgrade migration so existing canister state upgrades safely when introducing poll storage (initialize an empty poll store and any per-user vote index needed) without losing existing media/live/comment/profile data.
acceptanceCriteria: On upgrade, the canister preserves existing media, live sessions, user profiles, and comments.
On upgrade, polls storage is initialized to empty when no prior polls exist.
Deployment does not fail due to missing fields in upgraded state.

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks for polls: fetch all polls, fetch a single poll, create a poll, and vote on a poll. Ensure caches update immediately after create/vote (invalidate/refetch the relevant queries).

quotes: Make polls were you ask questions and put this or this and it shows what percentage of ppl like who

acceptanceCriteria: There are React Query hooks that wrap the new backend poll APIs.
After creating a poll, the polls list updates without a manual reload.
After voting, the poll’s displayed vote counts/percentages update without a manual reload.
Errors are surfaced as clear English messages (e.g., not signed in).

requirements.text: Add a new Polls page to the app with: (1) a list of existing polls (newest first), (2) a poll creation form for signed-in users (question + 2+ options with add/remove option controls), and (3) a poll voting UI where users can select an option and immediately see percentage results per option. Guests can browse polls but must sign in to create/vote (show an English prompt).

quotes: Make polls were you ask questions and put this or this and it shows what percentage of ppl like who

acceptanceCriteria: A Polls route/page exists and is reachable from the main navigation.
Guests can view the polls list and per-poll results UI but cannot vote or create; the UI shows an English sign-in prompt.
Signed-in users can create a poll (question + at least 2 options).
Signed-in users can vote on a poll; after voting, the UI shows percentages for each option (and handles 0 total votes gracefully).
The UI prevents creating polls with fewer than 2 non-empty options and prevents voting without selecting an option, with clear English feedback.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; no additional backend services.

Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui; compose existing UI components instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding poll comments, poll sharing, or moderation tooling.
Adding third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity.
Associating polls to specific videos/shorts unless explicitly requested later.
